import { Body, Controller, Param, Post, Put } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Column, Entity, Repository } from 'typeorm';

export class CreateNoteDto {
  title!: string;
  summary?: string;
}

export class LegacyNoteDto {
  title!: string;
  legacyCode!: number;
}

@Entity('note')
export class Note {
  @Column({ name: 'note_title' })
  title!: string;

  @Column()
  slug!: string;

  @Column()
  reviewed!: boolean;
}

function externalMap(value: string): string {
  return value;
}

export class NotesService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Note)
    private readonly notes: Repository<Note>,
  ) {}

  // CASE:provenance-inter-method
  create(dto: CreateNoteDto): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.notes.insert({ title: dto.title });
  }
}

@Controller('notes')
export class ProvenanceController {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Note)
    private readonly notes: Repository<Note>,
    private readonly service: NotesService,
  ) {}

  // CASE:provenance-direct
  @Post('direct')
  direct(@Body() dto: CreateNoteDto): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.notes.insert({ title: dto.title });
  }

  // CASE:provenance-derived
  @Put(':id/slug')
  derived(@Param('id') id: string, @Body() dto: CreateNoteDto): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.notes.update(id, { slug: dto.title.trim().toLowerCase() });
  }

  // CASE:provenance-destructured
  @Post('destructured')
  destructured(@Body() dto: CreateNoteDto): Promise<unknown> {
    const { title } = dto;
    return this.notes.insert({ title });
  }

  // CASE:provenance-criterion-not-write
  @Put(':id/review')
  review(@Param('id') id: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.notes.update(id, { reviewed: true });
  }

  // CASE:provenance-static-field
  @Post('static')
  staticField(@Body() dto: CreateNoteDto): Promise<unknown> {
    void dto;
    return this.notes.insert({ title: 'system' });
  }

  // CASE:provenance-ambiguous-origin
  @Post('ambiguous')
  ambiguous(@Body() dto: CreateNoteDto | LegacyNoteDto): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.notes.insert({ title: dto.title });
  }

  // CASE:provenance-spread
  @Post('spread')
  spread(@Body() dto: CreateNoteDto): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.notes.insert({ ...dto });
  }

  // CASE:provenance-computed-key
  @Post('computed')
  computed(@Body() dto: CreateNoteDto, key: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.notes.insert({ [key]: dto.title });
  }

  // CASE:provenance-external-mapper
  @Post('mapped')
  mapped(@Body() dto: CreateNoteDto): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.notes.insert({ title: externalMap(dto.title) });
  }

  // CASE:provenance-save-unknown-columns
  @Post('save')
  save(@Body() dto: CreateNoteDto): Promise<Note> {
    return this.notes.save({ title: dto.title });
  }

  // CASE:provenance-inter-method
  @Post()
  create(@Body() dto: CreateNoteDto): Promise<unknown> {
    return this.service.create(dto);
  }
}
